heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 88–448, title IV, § 402(a)(2), Aug. 19, 1964, 78 Stat. 492

notes.text: Section, R.S. § 2074, related to holding of two offices. See section 5533 of Title 5, Government Organization and Employees.

notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.text: Repeal effective on first day of first month which begins later than the 90th day following Aug. 19, 1964, see Pub. L. 88–448, title IV, § 403, Aug. 19, 1964, 78 Stat. 496.
